text_block_list.text: One day, after reaching a milestone in my time with <chrname>—quite some time had passed since Saint Light and the others left the academy.
Though our days are as fulfilling as ever, almost as if nothing had changed... a slight sense of loneliness lingers.
The time spent sharing drinks with them almost feels like a dream. As I walk along, absentmindedly pondering these thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Hey hey, did you watch yesterday's show?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The talk show Haiseiko-san appeared on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She shared stories from her time here at the academy!
I'm pretty sure she was talking about Falco and the others~☆

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: 『—Yes, exactly! I took a small break from my activities to spend some time at the academy, but...』

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: 『All my juniors were such wonderful girls♪ When I held a mini-live on campus, they were so thrilled... I felt like I was the one receiving energy from them!』

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: 『Oh yes, and there was a very kind Trainer too! I was able to deepen our bond with the adults as well♪』

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: 『To be able to update my precious memories of the academy like this... I am truly grateful for such a valuable opportunity!』

It seems Haiseiko truly cherishes the time she spent at the academy.
Walking through the campus with a warm feeling in my heart—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!
Do you have a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: A letter has arrived for you from Saint Light-san.
The letter handed to me was written in an astonishingly exquisite hand. Although it took some time to decipher the contents, it appeared to be an invitation to a party—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: 『On this occasion, I have established a new fund for horse girls in need of financial assistance for their higher education.』

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: 『Support must be enduring. It requires many people to join hands and cooperate together.』

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: 『I would be delighted if you could witness how this intent is being shared, and allow me to share my feelings with you.』

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: 『—To help elevate the perspective of someone who will continue supporting the Twinkle Series... That is my sole wish.』
Receiving such an honorable letter from Saint Light fills my heart with immense pride—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, understood.
I will let them know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking time out of your busy schedule.
Please feel free to contact me anytime... for whatever you need.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, hello there. It is you.
We were just speaking about you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Speed Symboli was praising you quite highly—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yes, so please be sure to tell Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: If he ever diligently considers wanting to work for the URA in the future... I am ready to consult with him anytime.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Though I say that half in jest.
He would surely wish to see his duties as a Trainer through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Though I say that half in jest.
She would surely wish to see her duties as a Trainer through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet I mean it half seriously as well. Well, putting that aside...
Rudolf, please tell him this.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet I mean it half seriously as well. Well, putting that aside...
Rudolf, please tell her this.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—I am rooting for you.
For both of your futures... as your senior 'legend.'

—A profound joy gradually wells up within my chest.
The days we spent together truly exist within them.

text_block_list.text:
Holding the lessons learned from them deep in my heart.
Until <chrname> carves her name as a legend—
